notes.title: MULTIPLAYER RELEASE UPDATE 2.0.0
notes.notes:
[p]Multiplayer is here!
It's been a while... Adding multiplayer meant I had to overhaul a lot of my code so if you spot any bugs be sure to report them so they may be fixed.[/p][p]Patch notes: [/p][p]-ADDED MULTIPLAYER
-Seeded generation and entity spawning
-Menu Changes
-More graphic options and lighting improvements
-Branching paths can now spawn before Swallows lair
-Made elevator rooms about twice as common past distance 100+
-Added a lil black fade when the level is started
-Lowered walk speed 600 -> 500
-Lowered sprint speed 1600 -> 1400
-Made walking backwards 33%~ slower
-Increased stamina 200 -> 250
-Lowered Eyegel speed 1475 -> 1300
-Lowered Eyegel chase time 7.5 -> 6.6
-Changed Lurks sound
-Removed the weird shine that was sometimes on Sightstealers face
-Added small bits of damage to some of the walls
-Gray candy time 25 -> 30 and made visual effect less strong
-Other random small adjustments not worth writing...[/p][p]The game is now in version 2.0.0 and I consider it to be finished in terms of the game I set out to make. However, that doesn't mean I wont be adding more updates based on what I feel the game needs, player feedback or just what I want to add for fun. besides bug fixes, expect potential future updates to improve on the multiplayer system and maybe even a whole new level...[/p]

notes.title: DON'T EXIST is out now!
notes.notes:
[b]I'd like to take this opportunity to talk about what I have planned next![/b]
 
-More entities
-More stores
-More possible mall room layouts and sizes
-More items that can be found laying around
-More posters
-And overall just more stuff you'd expect to find in an infinite mall
-Maybe something else ??? :)

[u]Future stretch goals[/u]

I'll start with the big one most you probably care about. multiplayer.
This is something I would love to add though implementing it (particularly as a solo dev) takes a lot of time. Still, assuming you all like this game and its concept and don't bury it with negative reviews, this is definitely something I could see getting added at some point in the future!

Other entire levels. Another future goal would be to add more levels instead of it being just the Mall, this would come in version 2.0.0 and would also be accompanied by a hunger system. For an idea of what that level might be you can check out this: https://dontexistbackrooms.editorx.io/home/blog

notes.title: Coming April 26th!
notes.notes:
DON'T EXIST is on track to release Friday 26th April 2024!

Let me know if it's the Entities the Mall or maybe something else that you care most about so I'll know what to spend more time on!

Game description: In this experimental horror wander the endless procedurally generated mall and encounter the strange and unique entities that inhabit it. Death is your best guide in learning how to exist in this place.
